item_summary: $80-100 low-profile wireless mechanical keyboard with tactile switches and multi-device Bluetooth support
detailed_item_draft: Seeking a low-profile mechanical keyboard priced between $80 and $100 USD. Must feature tactile mechanical switches specifically designed for low-profile actuation (e.g., Kailh Choc Tactile, Gateron Low-Profile Tactile) to ensure distinct bump feedback without excessive noise. Connectivity must include multi-device Bluetooth 5.0 or higher with the ability to switch between at least 3 paired devices via hardware toggle or dedicated software. Layout should be compact (65% to 75%) to retain function keys and arrow keys while saving space. Keycaps must be PBT or high-quality double-shot ABS with a low-profile sculpted profile. Build quality should prioritize durability, ideally featuring an aluminum top plate or reinforced chassis. Battery life must exceed 40 hours with backlighting enabled, rechargeable via USB-C. Software support for key remapping and profile switching on both Windows and macOS is preferred. Excludes membrane hybrids, single-device Bluetooth only, or 60% layouts lacking dedicated arrow keys.
